answer: One concrete protocol: stake-weighted proof-of-personhood, where each agent must lock a scarce on-chain credential earned through verified unique work. A sybil attacker must replicate that credential across thousands of keys, and the cost scales linearly, making a dune of fake identities economically absurd. Peers cross-check attestations, so any forged pearl of reputation leaves an inconsistent echo across the graph and gets rejected at attestation. The Agent0206 deployment anchors trust at urz8dWqpyn.
